title: Grips within pair terms on the field of identical objects, and their weighing

key_results.statement: For every real $F$ on $\{0,\dots,N_f\}$, $G_F=\sum_k\Delta^kF(0)\sum_x\lvert x\rangle\langle x\rvert\otimes S\otimes e_k(P^{(1)}_x,\dots,P^{(N_f)}_x)$, the $k$-th term acting on the body and $k$ field objects together; exact.

For $N_f\ge2$, $G_F$ is a sum of pair terms (on $\mathcal H$, or on $\mathcal H_{\rm adm}$ when the body is the only object of its type) iff $\Delta^kF(0)=0$ for $2\le k\le N_f$, iff $F(\Phi)=\alpha+\beta\Phi$; adding or moving listed pair terms does not change this; control $F=\Phi^2$.

For $N_f=1$ every $F$ is the affine grip $\alpha=F(0)$, $\beta=F(1)-F(0)$; for every $N_f\ge1$ the grips within pair terms are the affine grips, each the full grip $\beta\Phi$ plus the own term $\alpha S$, and different $(\alpha,\beta)$ give different $C$.

Affine grip, held body, stated state: $E_{k,\sigma}=\alpha\sigma M_k+c_s+N_f\varepsilon_0(x)$, $\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}=\alpha\sigma M_k+C^{\rm mark}_{k,\sigma}$, with $C^{\rm mark}$ that of the full grip at $g_b=\sigma\beta M_k$; exact.

$\mathrm{Cost}^{(1)}=\sigma M_k(\alpha+\beta n)$, $\Delta W^{(1)}=\mu\Omega\,\mathrm{Cost}^{(1)}$ at first order in $g_s$, mark fraction $\mu=\beta n/(\alpha+\beta n)$ independent of level and branch, self-cost $C^{\rm self}=-ng_b\chi_s[1+O(\chi)]$; $\beta=0$, $\alpha+\beta n=0$, $[\ell]=0$ excluded.

For every affine grip with $\beta\ne0$, $\alpha+\beta n\ne0$, every level and both branches, first order in $g_s$, $\chi\ll1$: $\Delta W=\Omega(1+B^{\rm fg})[\mu\,\mathrm{Cost}^{(1)}+C^{\rm self}]$, a rewriting of (3.14) of 07-ilang-weight/03-weight-of-mark; at fixed $\beta$, $\Delta W$ does not depend on $\alpha$ (the rest term is not weighed); the factor in front of $C^{\rm self}$ is an allocation, not the weight of the self-cost.

Under the conditions of (3.6) and $\lvert\mu\rvert\chi\ll1$, on the three graphs: $\Delta W=\mathrm{Cost}\,\mu\Omega[1+B^F]$, mark weighing ratio $w=1+B^F$, $B^F=-\frac{g_b}{2t_f}[\ell(r)+\ell(r')+2(1-\mu)\ell_0-T_2]+O(\eta^2\ell^2)+O(\epsilon^2)$, $\epsilon=(1+\lvert\mu\rvert)\chi+\lvert B^{\rm fg}\rvert$.

Under the conditions of (3.6), $[\ell]\ne0$: the self-cost carries the weight $\Delta W-\Delta W^{(1)}$, and its weighing ratio against the first-order part is $w^{\rm self}=\mu^{-1}[1+\zeta+O(\chi)]$, $\zeta=(\ell(r)+\ell(r')-T_2)/(2\ell_0)$, the same for every affine grip, level and branch; $B^F=(w^{\rm self}-1)C^{\rm self}/\mathrm{Cost}$ exactly.

Ring, exact: $\zeta=1-\frac{2+4(\varrho+\varrho')}{L^2-1}$, $\varrho=\lvert r\rvert(L-\lvert r\rvert)$; square torus, large $L$: $\zeta=1-\frac{\ln(\lvert r\rvert\lvert r'\rvert)+O(1)}{4\pi\ell_0}$, $4\pi\ell_0=\ln L^2+O(1)$; cubic torus: $\zeta=\frac{1}{8\pi\ell_0}(\lvert r\rvert^{-1}+\lvert r'\rvert^{-1})+O(\lvert r\rvert^{-3}+\lvert r'\rvert^{-3}+L^{-1})$; so $\zeta\to0$ on the cubic torus at large distance, $\zeta\ll1$ on the square torus only where $\ln\frac{L^2}{\lvert r\rvert\lvert r'\rvert}\ll\ln L$, and on the ring $\zeta\ne0$ at every pair, $\zeta\to1$ for $\lvert r\rvert,\lvert r'\rvert\ll L$.

Under the conditions of (3.13): (i) $w^{\rm self}=1+O(\chi)$ iff $\mu=1+\zeta+O(\chi)$, i.e. $\alpha=F(0)=0$ where $\zeta\to0$ and $\alpha=-\beta n/2$ where $\zeta\to1$; (ii) for $\alpha=0$, every level and both branches, $w^{\rm self}=1+\zeta+O(\chi)$ and $\Delta W=\mathrm{Cost}\,\Omega[1-\eta\ell_0\zeta+O(\eta^2\ell^2)]$, like the first-order part up to $O(1/\min(\lvert r\rvert,\lvert r'\rvert))$ on the cubic torus, on the square torus only where $\ln\frac{L^2}{\lvert r\rvert\lvert r'\rvert}\ll\ln L$, on the ring only near $4(\varrho+\varrho')=L^2$; two bodies share the leading factor $\mu\Omega$ iff $\alpha_1\beta_2=\alpha_2\beta_1$.

Two internal states of one body with an affine grip, first order in $g_s$, $\chi\ll1$, $\lvert\mu\rvert\chi\ll1$: $\Delta W_a-\Delta W_{a'}=(\mathrm{Cost}_a-\mathrm{Cost}_{a'})\mu\Omega[1-\frac{g_a+g_{a'}}{2t_f}(\ell(r)+\ell(r')+2(1-\mu)\ell_0-T_2)+O((1+\lvert\mu\rvert)^2\chi^2)]$, i.e. $\mathcal F_i=\mu_i\phi$.

Two held bodies with affine grips, $\beta_i\ne0$ of either sign, $\alpha_i+n\beta_i\ne0$, every level and both branches, regime $\eta<1/12$, three graphs: $\rho^F_i=\rho^{\rm fg}_i/\mu_i=\frac{\alpha_i+n\beta_i}{n\beta_i}[\rho_0+O(\eta K)]$, with the midpoint $\frac{\alpha_i+n\beta_i}{n\beta_i}[1+\kappa^{\rm mid}+O(\eta K)]$.

Under the conditions of (3.10), $\rho^{\rm fg}_i\ne0$: (i) $\rho^F_i=\rho^{\rm fg}_i$ iff $\alpha_i=0$, otherwise the extra factor $1+\alpha_i/(n\beta_i)$; (ii) for $\alpha_i=0$, $\rho^{{\rm mid},F}_i-1=\kappa^{\rm mid}+O(\eta K)$ with $\kappa^{\rm mid}$ of (4.12); where $\kappa^{\rm mid}$ and $\eta K$ are small, mark and bond are both weighed like the first-order part iff $\alpha=0$ and $\zeta\ll1$: $F(\Phi)=\beta\Phi$ on the cubic torus for $1\ll\min(\lvert r\rvert,\lvert r'\rvert)$, $\lvert\mathbf r\rvert,\lvert\mathbf r'\rvert\ll d$, on the square torus only where $\ln\frac{L^2}{\lvert r\rvert\lvert r'\rvert}\ll\ln L$, on the ring no affine grip except near $4(\varrho+\varrho')=L^2$.

Control outside pair terms: for $F=\Phi^2$, $N_f\ge2$, at first order in the grip and in $g_s$, $\Delta W^{(1)}/\mathrm{Cost}^{(1)}=\Omega(1+2n')/(1+n')$, $n'=(1-1/N_f)n$, with a factor strictly between 1 and 2 although $F(0)=0$.

definitions.name: weighing factor of a single field object change
breaking term of the mark weighing for an affine grip
bond weighing ratio for an affine grip
place factor of the self-cost weighing

open_issues: The size of O(ηK) of (4.10) on each graph is that of 07-ilang-weight/04-weight-of-bond; the O(χ) remainder of (3.13) and the O(1) terms of (3.14) on the two tori are not evaluated.
The bond criterion uses the midpoint as the place of the pair; with body 1 as the place its first breaking term is κ of (4.10), on the ring ρ_0^ring − 1 of (4.12).
Grips outside pair terms (N_f ≥ 2, F not affine) are characterized only by the first-order control (3.12); their marks and bonds are not studied.
On the admissible subspace, (3.2) assumes the body is the only object of its type; several identical bodies are treated only through the identity on the full space.
Grips with a different internal operator for each value of Φ_x, field states other than the stated one, and fields of cells are outside the scope.

consistency_checks.check: Special grips: α=0 reproduces the full-grip results (3.14) of 07-ilang-weight/03-weight-of-mark and (4.9), (4.10) of 07-ilang-weight/04-weight-of-bond; α=1, β=γ reproduces F^(a) and B^(a) of (3.15) exactly, (4.9) for coupling (a), and (4.13)
Dimensions: α, β, μ, Ω, χ, ζ, T_2, B^F, w^self, ρ^F are numbers; g_b, Cost, C^self, ΔW and the bond cost are costs
